lines.text: Many learners say: My parents are proud about me.
Better: My parents are proud of me.
Be proud of someone or something.
Of! We are proud of you.

data.wrong: My parents are proud about me.
data.right: My parents are proud of me.
data.why: Be proud of someone or something.
